A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DIPE work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary material support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: V1 reports original VQA experiments, attention analyses, MM-NIAH evaluation, and synthetic interleaving tests, with additional model and benchmark results in the supplement.

after.justification: V2 retains these original results and adds wall-clock latency measurements and packed-training efficiency results.

M1.justification: DIPE retains the same segment anchoring, dual query views, modality-masked attention, LogSumExp fusion, and KV-cache handling. The FlashAttention-to-FlexAttention revision changes the documented backend, without establishing a change to the underlying algorithm.

E1.justification: The training datasets, 19 VQA benchmarks, MM-NIAH image-reasoning task, and synthetic interleaving test remain unchanged. The added timing study concerns computational evaluation settings rather than new data or task coverage.

E2.justification: Existing comparisons retain Vanilla RoPE, MRoPE, MRoPE-I, and the same interleaving comparators. The new efficiency study compares MRoPE with its DIPE counterpart; FlexAttention is an implementation backend, not an added evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: V2 adds latency evaluation for full models and attention blocks, covering forward, backward, and single-token decoding across 1K–32K contexts, plus packed-training measurements. Existing accuracy protocols and supplementary training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new efficiency analysis examines DIPE's overhead across context lengths, computational phases, and packed versus unpacked execution (v2 Table 2 and Figure 6). Existing attention-decay, model-generalization, scaling, and interleaving analyses are retained.

E5.justification: V2 introduces ± values for latency measurements in Table 2, whereas v1 has no corresponding uncertainty reporting. Their statistical meaning and repeat counts are unspecified; the PDFs do not establish additional repetitions of existing accuracy experiments.

E6.justification: V2 adds latency results and packed-training curves. For example, Table 2 reports 8K full-model forward latency of 140.1±0.4 ms for MRoPE and 144.6±0.5 ms with DIPE. Existing accuracy tables, attention findings, and supplementary results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The RoPE formulations, DIPE attention equations, and supplementary derivation of LogSumExp fusion are unchanged. Replacing FlashAttention-specific wording in the derivation does not alter its mathematics.

C1.justification: The introduction replaces explicit full compatibility with FlashAttention with compatibility with modern efficient attention kernels, citing FlexAttention. The central visual-fading contribution, parameter-free integration, and long- versus short-context performance claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: V2 removes the assertion that split attention does not increase total FLOPs. It newly attributes runtime overhead to split attention and LogSumExp fusion and interprets packed-training measurements as showing small overhead. Existing explanations and limitations concerning visual fading remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and Algorithm 2 replace the documented FlashAttention calls with FlexAttention calls and identify mask-aware kernel support. Supplementary hyperparameters and the code-access link are unchanged. The new timing results lack hardware and detailed measurement instructions.

R1.justification: V2 adds the FlexAttention reference and removes the FlashAttention paper, reflecting the revised implementation account. Other research positioning is retained; removing a duplicate Qwen2-VL bibliography entry does not remove that cited work.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to the compatibility discussion, an added efficiency paragraph, expanded affiliations, and funding acknowledgements. Main-text running headers change to 'Authors Suppressed Due to Excessive Length'; the overall narrative and section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds a latency table and packed-training figure, corrects the SPE/APE panel references in Figure 2, and adjusts placement and sizing of existing displays. Subsequent figures and tables are renumbered, while supplementary displays retain their content.

improvement.justification: V2 clarifies the documented implementation, withdraws the unchanged-FLOPs assertion, and supplies measured runtime costs, making practical efficiency claims more assessable. Figure 2's corrected labels also improve clarity. The gain is limited: core accuracy evidence is unchanged, and missing timing hardware, repeat counts, and definitions of the ± values constrain reproducibility.
